blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Public Works Secretary Giovanni “Banoy” Lopez has ordered regional directors and district engineers of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) to conduct weekly inspections of roads, bridges and other infrastructure projects in their respective areas.
